exposure: Sodium levels (below 134 mEq/L vs. above 135 mEq/L)
cohort: 2,901 subjects aged 15 to 54 years with preeclampsia with severe features
finding: Hyponatremia in patients with preeclampsia with severe features was associated with greater use of emergency antihypertensives, antenatal steroids, and cesarean delivery.
